messages:
maya: Heads-up: us-west-2a GPU zone showing 30-45% node failures, autoscaler can't replace nodes. Starting zonal evacuation for node-pool-gpu-a. :rotating_light:

sre-bot: incident-bot created INC-2026-1273 - us-west-2a degraded (severity=high)

ashish: Confirming — seeing RCU errors and NVLINK disconnects. Rolling drains for affected nodes now. Will trigger traffic-shift policy.

maya: Plan: 1) cordon+drain affected nodes 2) shift new requests to us-west-2b/c via router policy 3) spin up 50 g4dn-equivalents in 2b/c as buffer 4) monitor KV cache miss spike. Anyone object?

ion: No objections. For drains use: `kubectl cordon <node>`; `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Start with oldest pods serving long-running sessions.

jess: Be careful with canary traffic — latency-sensitive Hosted API customers on dedicated pools might see 200-300ms spike. Suggest setting batch_size cap to 8 for next hour.

ops-lead: @maya add cost ack — spinning 50 GPUs will hit burst budget. Approve?

maya: Approve up to $12k/hr burst. We need availability >99.5% for affected tenants.

ashish: Started drain on nodes: gpu-node-uw2a-01..05. Router change queued: route-policy 'zonal-failover' to route 70% to 2b, 30% to 2c as canary. Rolling now.

deploy-bot: router policy change applied by ashish at 1753457800

ion: Watching autoscaler. It fails on provisioning due to AZ quota. Hitting vCPU quota in 2b. Requesting immediate quota bump to cloud support. Meanwhile we can borrow spare dedicated pool in 2c.

jess: If quota won't be fixed immediately, we should accelerate reclaiming idle nodes in 2b: identify long-idle jobs and preempt them.

ashish: Cloud support on chat — they can provision lower-priority instances (spot) but we prefer on-demand for stability. Starting reclaim script: `/scripts/reclaim-idle.sh --age 2h --pool node-pool-gpu-b`.

maya: Reminder: KV cache cold starts will increase token costs. Enable prefix-cache warmup for shifted models (warmup=30s) and pause expensive eval jobs in 2b.

ops-lead: Customer-impact: alerting SMT for customers >$50k/month; OOO for lower-tier. @jess please prepare short customer message.

jess: Draft message: 'We're experiencing degraded capacity in us-west-2a; traffic is being shifted to other zones. Some latency and cold-cache effects may occur. We'll update in 30 mins.'

ashish: Drain progress: nodes 01-03 drained, 04 failing to terminate due to stuck GPU driver. Escalating to hw-team.

hw-tech: Checked logs: kernel oops on gpu-node-uw2a-04. Applying remote reboot via BMC, staging replacement node.

ion: Autoscaler now reports success for 20 instances in 2c, 15 in 2b. Routing at 1000 qps showing 2b 65%, 2c 35% after ramp.

maya: Monitoring dashboards: token latency P95 jumped from 120ms -> 210ms for shifted traffic. CVs stable. Keeping canary for 15 more mins then full evacuation.

ashish: Full evacuation scheduled at 1753460100. After that, we will mark zone as degraded in docs and kick off postmortem.

sre-bot: INC-2026-1273 updated: status=investigating->mitigating

jess: Customer messages sent to on-call list and top customers. :white_check_mark:

ops-lead: Thanks team. After evac, gather list of affected instances and cost run-rate. Postmortem owner: ashish.
